subject.title: [Feature Request] Session List: Show timestamp + last message preview

question: Should the Control UI Sessions list adopt mailbox-style last-message previews now by repairing or replacing https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/48396, or should this be folded into a broader sessions workspace design?
rationale: The source gap is clear and bounded, but an open same-author PR already attempts the work and related product-direction issues cover broader session overview and activity-ordering behavior.

options.title: Repair or replace the linked PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/48396 if it can be updated to current paths, correct lastMessagePreview wiring, focused tests, and real UI proof; otherwise create an equivalent narrow replacement.

options.title: Fold into sessions workspace
options.body: Track this preview line as part of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80901 if maintainers want one coordinated sessions workspace rather than incremental table polish.

options.title: Defer the UX change
options.body: Leave the current Sessions table unchanged until a maintainer explicitly sponsors the preview behavior and proof requirements.

recommendation.title: Repair or replace the linked PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/48396 if it can be updated to current paths, correct lastMessagePreview wiring, focused tests, and real UI proof; otherwise create an equivalent narrow replacement.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is connected to the original preview commit and adjacent session-routing history, and is the best available owner for the product choice among the traced candidates.
